description: Returns federal Direct Loan borrowing limits in force on a date. From July 1, 2026 (P.L. 119-21 sec. 81001): Grad PLUS ends for new borrowers; graduate unsubsidized $20,500 a year / $100,000 aggregate; professional $50,000 a year / $200,000 aggregate; Parent PLUS $20,000 a year and $65,000 total per dependent student across all parents; $257,500 lifetime cap; less-than-full-time proration; the interim exception for students enrolled with a loan on June 30, 2026. Undergraduate limits ($5,500-$7,500 dependent, $9,500-$12,500 independent) from the FSA Handbook.

borrower_type.description: dependent_undergraduate, independent_undergraduate, graduate, professional, parent_plus or all (default).

date.description: Date the period of instruction begins, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (2026-11-02).

name: get_federal_loan_limits
title: Federal student loan limits before and after July 1, 2026
